content.heroBio: I'm an AI engineer who builds things end to end, including multi-agent LLM systems, ML models, full-stack applications and large-scale data pipelines. My work has taken me across aerospace, state government databases, and teaching CS at UIUC, where I earned a BS and MCS in Computer Science and won 3rd place at the Ashby Prize at NCSA.
storyParagraphs: I'm a CS graduate from UIUC with both a Bachelor's and Master's degree, specializing in Intelligence and Data. My time at Illinois built a rigorous foundation in algorithms, systems, and applied AI that carries into every problem I work on today.

The work I find most interesting sits at the intersection of AI and production infrastructure. I've built multi-agent RAG systems serving 600+ users, optimized billion-record databases at the state government level, won the Ashby Prize at the NCSA AI Innovation Hackathon, and taught software engineering and database concepts to 800+ students. Each role pushed me into unfamiliar territory, and I kept going back for more.

I am currently building AI at RAVE Aerospace: LLM-powered pipelines for aircraft data management, predictive maintenance models for in-flight entertainment systems, full-stack and data engineering infrastructure. I enjoy working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where I can learn new technologies and make a meaningful, positive impact. I'm always open to connecting with others who are passionate about AI, software engineering, and solving interesting problems.
